doc_01.source:
schema: graph_cli.policy/1
id: graph
types:
  "files:File": read
obligations:
  - {action: ["write.*"], max_batch: 200}
deny:
  - {id: importer_no_files, role: [importer], action: ["write.*"], type: ["files:File"]}

doc_02.source:
schema: graph_cli.policy/1
id: installation
roles:
  importer: {description: "Importers: findings and their sources in example_graph"}
grants:
  - entrypoint: server
    principal: {role: importer}
    graphs: [example_graph]
    level: read
    writes:
      ex:Finding:
        create: [title, summary, status]
        update: [status, notes]
        link: [ex:about]
        transition: true
      ex:Source:
        create: true
        link: true
scopes:
  example_project: {example_graph: write}
no_project: {"*": read}

test_roles.GRANT_HEAVY_GRAPH.source:
schema: graph_cli.policy/1
id: graph
types:
  "files:File": read
  "inv:*": read
  "ex:Finding": write
obligations:
  - {action: ["write.transition"], require_reason: true}
deny:
  - {id: no_retract_by_explore, agent_type: explore, action: [write.retract], type: ["inv:*"]}
  - {id: no_decision_writes, role: [importer], action: ["write.*"],
     type: ["ex:Decision", "ex:Note"]}
  - {id: no_alias, agent_type: [explore], action: ["write.alias", "write.supersede"],
     type: ["ex:*"]}

test_write_grants.INSTALLATION.source:
schema: graph_cli.policy/1
id: installation
roles:
  importer: {description: "Importers: notes and topics"}
  tagger: {description: "Taggers: update notes"}
grants:
  - entrypoint: server
    principal: {role: importer}
    graphs: [example_graph]
    level: read
    writes:
      nas:Note:
        create: [title, body, kind]
        update: [body, kind]
        link: [nas:about]
        unlink: false
        transition: [status]
        retract: true
      nas:Topic:
        create: true
        link: true
        supersede: true
        alias: true
  - entrypoint: server
    principal: {role: tagger}
    graphs: [example_graph, other_graph]
    level: read
    writes:
      nas:Note: {update: [kind]}
no_project: {"*": read}
